title: Make virtualization CSS fixtures portable across focused-launcher working directories
outcome: Focused launcher runs can execute AgentSessionPanel.virtualization's production-CSS checks without an ignored cwd bridge, while retaining the same observable layout assertions.
acceptance: AgentSessionPanel.virtualization resolves the real production stylesheet independently of the caller's working directory, or the focused launcher exposes a supported explicit working directory used by this suite.

The four checkpoint/history/virtualization modules run with all 58 existing behavioral tests and pass through an eligible registered focused run without the temporary ignored config bridge; the original six ENOENT failures remain documented.
